content.title: How the mobile rink rental process works
content.subtitle: The quote process is designed to collect the right details early so the team can review the event realistically and recommend the next best steps.

steps.title: Share event details
steps.text: Tell us the date, city, venue type, estimated attendance, and what kind of skating experience you want to create.

steps.title: Review space, surface, and access
steps.text: The available footprint, surface condition, delivery path, power needs, and guest-flow plan help determine what setup can work.

steps.title: Plan rink size, layout, and support needs
steps.text: Rink size, barriers, skates, benches, skate aids, lighting, music, signage, staffing, and add-on support can be reviewed together.

steps.title: Confirm quote and event setup plan
steps.text: Once the details are reviewed, the team can outline availability, package direction, setup expectations, and next steps.

items.question: What types of events can use a portable ice rink?
items.answer: Portable ice rinks can work for corporate events, holiday activations, winter festivals, schools, municipalities, shopping centers, private venues, resorts, and community celebrations.

items.question: Can a rink be installed indoors or outdoors?
items.answer: Many requests can be reviewed for indoor or outdoor venues. The final recommendation depends on the surface, access, footprint, event duration, guest flow, and weather-related planning needs.

items.question: What information is needed for a quote?
items.answer: Helpful details include the event date, city and state, venue type, available surface, estimated attendance, desired rental window, and any support items you want included.

items.question: Do you provide skates, barriers, and event support?
items.answer: Skates, barriers, benches, skate aids, lighting, music, signage, staffing conversations, and add-on event support can be reviewed as part of the rental plan.

items.question: How far in advance should we request pricing?
items.answer: Request pricing as early as possible, especially for holiday dates, multi-day activations, corporate events, and public-space rentals that require more planning time.

content.title: Ready to plan your ice rink rental?
